Ellen — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the docs. Couple of next steps from Procurement/Accounts Payable side:

1) AP requires a copy of the updated W-9 (you provided — good).
2) For bank/account changes we need one of the following: voided check, bank letter (you provided), or a bank verification form completed by the vendor and signed.
3) Please confirm whether the legal-entity change affects the tax ID on the W-9. If the EIN changed, we’ll need the updated EIN documentation.
4) Confirm preferred effective date for changing the vendor record (you suggested 2026-04-01).

For the outstanding invoice SS-0319: we typically pay against the vendor record on file at time of payment run. If you want the March cycle to route to the new account, we can request an expedited update from AP but will need the voided check or bank confirmation and a signed vendor change form by EOD 03/27 to make the 03/31 payment run.

Laura (AP) — can you confirm Redwood’s internal checklist and whether an expedited update is feasible?

Marissa — looping you in since this touches account terms for Sapphire; if the entity name changed please confirm contract/PO implications.

Best,
